description: Sani Building Corp deterministic estimating guardrails. AI interprets scope; these rules sanity-check production quantities before pricing is accepted.

interiorPainting.notes: Use fewer SF per hour (more labor) for heavy patching, occupied spaces, detailed trim, high ceilings or difficult access.

engineeredHardwood.notes: Subfloor repair/leveling, furniture moving, stairs and unusual access are additional.

largeFormatTile24x48.notes: Demo, substrate repair, waterproofing and plumbing are separate operations.

alternativePricing.rule: When Option A and Option B are alternatives, only the selected/base option contributes to labor, materials and Grand Total. Other options remain separately quoted.

healthChecks: every selected trade has labor coverage
customer-supplied finish purchases are excluded while installation and rough materials remain included
mutually exclusive options are not double-counted
production hours meet documented quantity guardrails
service subtotals reconcile to the project total
low-confidence assumptions are surfaced for contractor review
